text.arabic_uthmani: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

words.gloss_range: exclamatory maṣdar of glorification and transcendence, performing declaration rather than merely describing praise
words.root_gloss_range: root range joining motion through a medium or orbiting movement with declaring divine transcendence from deficiency
words.prose: {{ar:سُبْحَٰنَ}} ({{tr:subḥāna}}) opens the ayah as an enacted declaration, not a neutral description: the accusative maṣdar compresses an implied act of glorifying into one formula. The root's motion and remoteness pressure makes the praise feel like distancing God from deficiency, while the same surah keeps that motion field alive in cosmic movement (36:40) and returns to the same glorification formula at the close (36:83). After the prior demand for gratitude, the opening shifts the register into the proper verbal response.

topics.headline: exclamatory maṣdar performs glorification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by performing glorification, not merely by reporting that God is praiseworthy.
topics.reason: The QAC row and ellipsis evidence identify an accusative maṣdar with an implied governing act, matching the CRITICAL claim.

topics.headline: motion image supports transcendence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root's motion field gives the declaration a felt movement of distancing God from deficiency.
topics.reason: The local formula selects theological glorification, while root-family evidence and same-surah motion at 36:40 preserve motion as image-pressure rather than a separate local action.

topics.headline: gratitude challenge becomes glorification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the move from challenged human gratitude into an explicit act of transcendence-language.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL boundary rows and same-surah recurrence at 36:83 cohere with the fresh doxological launch.

words.gloss_range: masculine singular relative pronoun that identifies the glorified referent through the following creative act
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) leaves the divine referent unnamed at first and makes the reader move into the relative clause to know Him by the act that follows. The pronoun therefore turns the opening glorification into an evidence-bearing statement: praise is attached to the one who created, not left as an isolated formula.

topics.headline: referent identified through creative agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sentence identifies God by His creative act rather than by inserting a divine name.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence treats the pronoun as introducing the relative clause that identifies the glorified referent.

topics.headline: relative pronoun pivots praise into warrant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar forces the exclamation forward into its proof.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is incomplete without its following ṣila, so the structure naturally bridges glorification into the creative predicate.

words.gloss_range: completed divine creating and measured fashioning of paired kinds; false fabrication is outside the local frame
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes creating, forming, proportioning, and in other contexts fabricating; local divine agency and object select genuine measured creation
words.prose: {{ar:خَلَقَ}} ({{tr:khalaqa}}) carries the hidden singular divine subject supplied by the relative pronoun, so the creative agency remains compact but clear. Its perfect aspect presents the creation of the pairs as accomplished, while the following source phrases unfold where that completed creative order is seen. The root's measuring and forming pressure matters here because paired kinds imply proportioned counterpartness; the false-fabrication branch is blocked by the divine agent and the created object.

topics.headline: perfect verb with hidden divine subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine agency is grammatically present without being repeated by name, and that the act is framed as accomplished.
topics.reason: QAC and implicit-argument evidence identify a Form I perfect verb with a 3ms subject controlled by the preceding relative pronoun.

topics.headline: measured fashioning of pairs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the created pairs are not random items but proportioned counterparts within a made order.
topics.reason: Dictionary evidence permits forming and proportioning pressure, while the divine relative clause and direct object block any local false-fabrication reading.

topics.headline: one creation verb governs the source triad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one completed creative act organizes earth-growth, human selves, and unknown domains under a single frame.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the following source phrases to the governing verb, and the CRITICAL rows give same-surah creation links at 36:79 and 36:81.

words.gloss_range: definite plural of paired kinds and counterparts, broader than spouses but still carrying complementarity rather than mere categories
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers mate, spouse, counterpart, kind, and paired completion; local distribution selects universal paired kinds with counterpart force
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ}} ({{tr:al-azwāja}}) is the direct object of the creation verb, so the created thing is paired kinds themselves, not merely the later source domains. The definite plural, reinforced by the next totalizer, claims the whole class. Its lexical range has to hold both kind and counterpart: plants, humans, and unknown domains stretch it beyond spouses alone, but the root still keeps complementarity and completion in view.

topics.headline: definite plural object claims the class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah makes paired kinds the created object and treats them as a comprehensive class.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the word the direct object of the creation verb, with the following totalizer apposed to it.

topics.headline: kind and counterpart both survive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word reaches beyond marriage into created kinds while preserving the felt relation of counterpartness.
topics.reason: The three source domains require broader kinds, while the root evidence and paired object keep complementarity active.

topics.headline: one object distributed across three domains
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the scale change from concrete provision into a universal taxonomy of paired reality.
topics.reason: The object is stated once and then unpacked through the three coordinated source phrases; same-root echoes include botanical pair contexts and 36:56.

words.gloss_range: attached totalizer and emphatic apposition sealing the created pairs as exceptionless before the domains are listed
words.root_gloss_range: root range of complete aggregate and totality; local form selects comprehensive scope tied by suffix to the previous object
words.prose: {{ar:كُلَّهَا}} ({{tr:kullahā}}) is not loose emphasis. As an accusative tawkīd with the suffix referring back to the paired kinds, it locks totality to that specific object and leaves no remainder outside the claim. Its position matters: the scope is sealed first, and only then do the earth, self, and unknown domains unfold inside it.

topics.headline: suffix anchors exceptionless totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that totality is grammatically attached to the created pairs, not floating as a general intensifier.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the word as apposition to the object, and the suffix refers back to the broken plural as a collective.

topics.headline: totality seal precedes the triad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah establishes total scope before naming any source domain.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows correctly observe that the totalizer comes before the coordinated source phrases and turns local provision into an exceptionless created scope.

words.gloss_range: fused source expression from preposition plus relative pronoun, opening the first partitive and explicative domain
words.prose: {{ar:مِمَّا}} ({{tr:mimmā}}) packs sourcehood and relative reference into one word: it marks the first domain as from among what the earth produces and waits for the following clause to complete its content. This first source phrase sets the template for the ordered triad, so the list begins with a visible botanical field before moving inward and then beyond human knowledge.

topics.headline: source marker waits for clause completion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first domain is grammatically a source category, not a second created object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the relative element governed by the source preposition and completed by the following relative clause.

topics.headline: first source phrase starts the triad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ordered expansion beginning with observable earth-growth.
topics.reason: The word begins the coordinated source-chain template repeated by the later source phrases.

topics.headline: nasal sound bond adds no separate payoff
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The audible fusion note repeats the already retained fusion and source-chain payoff without adding a distinct lexical or structural insight.
topics.reason: The row is not contradicted, but its reader-facing value is already preserved by the fused-relative-source topic.

words.gloss_range: ongoing Form IV causing-to-grow or producing, with earth as explicit feminine subject
words.root_gloss_range: root range of sprouting, emergence, and growth from a substrate; Form IV locally gives causative productive force
words.prose: {{ar:تُنۢبِتُ}} ({{tr:tunbitu}}) makes the first source domain active and visible. Its feminine form anticipates the earth as subject, and its imperfect aspect contrasts with the completed creation verb: creation is already established, while earth-production keeps appearing. Because the verb is Form IV, the earth is not merely where plants happen; it is grammatically cast as the producer that causes growth within the divine creation frame. The phrase also recalls earth-produce language in 2:61 and the revived agricultural sign of 36:33.

topics.headline: feminine imperfect points to earth's ongoing production
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contrast between completed creation and continuing visible growth.
topics.reason: The verb is imperfect 3fs and the attachment evidence makes earth its explicit subject.

topics.headline: Form IV assigns productive causation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that growth is presented as caused production from a substrate, not as a passive location of plants.
topics.reason: The Form IV evidence supports causative production, and the root evidence supplies emergence-from-substrate pressure.

topics.headline: growth phrase links provision and sign
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that botanical pairing grows out of a prior provision-sign field rather than appearing as an isolated plant note.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide the exact phrase echo at 2:61 and same-surah agricultural continuity with 36:33.

words.gloss_range: the definite earth as nominative producing ground and substrate, not political territory or mere scenery
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes earth, land, ground, breadth, and substrate; local growth verb selects the producing ground sense
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضُ}} ({{tr:al-arḍu}}) completes the first source domain as an explicit subject. The growth verb selects earth as low, broad productive ground or substrate, not territory, so the ayah lets the visible world stand as a mediated producer inside divine creation. The same-surah movement from dead earth revived in 36:33 to producing earth here turns revival into productive capacity.

topics.headline: earth is active grammatical producer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earth is not just a location but the explicit subject of production.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies earth as the subject of the growth verb.

topics.headline: ground-substrate sense selected
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the low broad substrate image behind the first domain of emergence.
topics.reason: The growth verb selects the ground and substrate branch; territory and tremor associations remain root background rather than local sense.

topics.headline: dead earth becomes producing earth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same-surah progression from revived earth to earth that actively produces paired kinds.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows tie this subject to the earth-sign sequence at 36:33 and to the concrete verb-subject completion of the first domain.

topics.headline: recitation flow adds no separate payoff
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The verb-subject continuity is already preserved by the explicit-producing-subject topic.
topics.reason: The sound observation is not needed once the grammatical and semantic continuity has been retained.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that gives the human-self source equal syntactic rank with the earth-growth source while marking a turn inward
words.prose: The first {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does more than continue the sentence. It coordinates the second source phrase with the first, preventing the human-self domain from being treated as an explanation of earth-growth. The list turns from outer visible production to inner human constitution while keeping both domains parallel, and the repeated wa-min / wa-mimmā onset makes the second and third domains audible as matched continuations.

topics.headline: coordination gives the self-domain parity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the self-domain is a new coordinated source, not an appositive restatement of the first domain.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the following phrase as coordinated with the first source phrase.

topics.headline: repeated onset marks parallel domains
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second and third domains as parallel continuations of the first.
topics.reason: The repeated coordinating onset supports the same parallel triadic structure identified by attachment evidence.

words.gloss_range: partitive and source-marking preposition governing the self-domain as an internal source of pairing
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) governs the following selves and marks them as a source-domain of the created pairs. In this middle slot, the source relation turns inward: after earth-growth, the ayah points to what is from within the human beings themselves, then moves onward to what they do not know. The nasal link between the preposition and the following self-word also lets the source marker and self-domain sound closely joined.

topics.headline: preposition turns sourcehood inward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second domain is sourced from within human beings, not simply added beside them.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following self-word governed by the preposition as a source complement of the creation verb.

topics.headline: middle phrase mediates visible and unknown
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ordered progression from external earth to internal selves to unavailable knowledge.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows identify the phrase as the middle member of the three coordinated source domains.

topics.headline: sound binds marker to self-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the source marker and self-domain as closely joined in recitation.
topics.reason: The row adds a small but distinct auditory payoff that reinforces the governed source phrase.

words.gloss_range: their selves or persons as an embodied, possessive, plural human source-domain of pairing
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers self, person, soul, breath, and life-interiority; local plural with suffix selects embodied persons as an internal source
words.prose: {{ar:أَنفُسِهِمْ}} ({{tr:anfusihim}}) makes the second source domain personal and internal. The suffix ties the selves to the same human collective already in view, while the genitive government keeps them as a source rather than an actor. The root range prevents a thin reading: the phrase reaches persons as embodied selves, not abstract psychology alone. Its echo of single-self creation in 4:1 broadens that logic into a human collective field.

topics.headline: suffix binds the source to the human collective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the source is the humans' own selves, grammatically governed and relationally attached.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence governs the word by the preceding preposition and identifies the suffix as referring to the human collective.

topics.headline: self means embodied personhood here
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the self-domain is bodily and personal as well as inward, not merely psychological.
topics.reason: Dictionary evidence supports self, person, breath, and life-interiority, while local grammar selects the plural possessed self-domain rather than activating every listed sense equally.

topics.headline: single-self creation pattern becomes collective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that creation-from-self pairing known from 4:1 is generalized here into a wider human source-domain.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give the 4:1 echo and local cooccurrence with creation and pairing roots.

words.gloss_range: final coordinating conjunction that adds the unknown source-domain at equal grammatical rank with the known domains
words.prose: The final {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens a third coordinated source-domain rather than making the unknown phrase a qualifier of the selves. Its joining force keeps the unknown grammatically equal to earth-growth and human selves, while the repeated onset lets the listener hear the last domain as the final step of the same ordered expansion.

topics.headline: unknown domain receives equal rank
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the unknown domain is grammatically parallel to the known domains, not subordinate to them.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the final source phrase with the earlier source phrases.

topics.headline: repeated conjunction marks the last step
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final source-domain arrive as a marked expansion into the unknown.
topics.reason: The final conjunction begins the last coordinated phrase and completes the repeated domain-boundary pattern.

words.gloss_range: final fused source expression whose relative element is both source referent and object of the negated knowing clause
words.prose: The final {{ar:مِمَّا}} ({{tr:mimmā}}) repeats the first source form but now opens onto what humans do not know. The same fused source expression makes the unknown domain parallel to earth-growth, yet the following negated knowledge clause leaves its content unfilled. The ayah's triad therefore moves from visible production to embodied interiority to an open epistemic boundary.

topics.headline: relative source carries epistemic opacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the unknown source is grammatically real but deliberately unnamed.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the relative element a source complement of the creation verb and the object absorbed by the final knowing verb.

topics.headline: repeated source form pivots to the unknown
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sharp contrast between the first filled source clause and the final unfilled unknown clause.
topics.reason: The repeated fused form parallels the first source phrase, while the final clause differs by ending in negated knowledge.

words.gloss_range: declarative negation scoping over the imperfect cognition verb and defining the final source-domain by human non-knowledge
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) makes the final domain an epistemic boundary. It is declarative negation, not a prohibition, and it scopes over the imperfect knowledge verb so that the clause reports ongoing human unknowing. The supplied variant that would shift the closing frame toward eating functions only as contrast; the local wording makes lack of knowledge, not consumption, the endpoint.

topics.headline: negation defines the final domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final category is defined from the human side by lack of knowledge.
topics.reason: QAC grammar and the final relative clause show declarative negation of the imperfect cognition verb.

topics.headline: negated clause closes the triad open-endedly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah lands without naming the last class, leaving the created-pair field open beyond human grasp.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cohere with the final-position negated relative clause and its open source reference.

topics.headline: variant tests consumption against knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the received local wording chooses an epistemic closure rather than a consumptive one.
topics.reason: The supplied variant is useful as contrast, but it does not govern the local Hafs surface, where negated knowledge is the closing mechanism.

words.gloss_range: ongoing plural knowing under negation, denying sure human grasp of the final source-domain
words.root_gloss_range: root range of knowing, certain apprehension, signs, and markers; local Form I under negation selects human non-knowledge rather than teaching
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamūna}}) closes the ayah with ongoing collective non-knowledge. Its plural subject resumes the human group, and the relative object remains absorbed in the preceding source expression, so the unknown is not named. The root's certainty and marker field sharpens the point: humans lack sure distinguishing grasp of the final domain. The eating-verb variant contrast makes the local choice sharper: cognition, not consumption, is the axis of the final source. Same-surah and wider echoes sharpen the contrast between divine knowledge and human limits (2:30; 36:16; 36:26; 36:76), while the long -ūna close lets that epistemic boundary resonate after the claim that all paired kinds were created.

topics.headline: imperfect plural closes with human unknowing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final limit belongs to humans collectively and is ongoing, not a momentary missing fact.
topics.reason: The verb is imperfect 3mp under negation, with its subject inferred as the human collective and its object supplied by the relative source expression.

topics.headline: root pressure denies sure distinguishing grasp
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negation concerns reliable apprehension and distinguishing access, not just an incomplete inventory.
topics.reason: Dictionary evidence supports certainty and sign-marker pressure, while Form I keeps the local action as knowing or not knowing rather than teaching.

topics.headline: variant contrast keeps cognition central
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the chosen surface makes cognition the axis of the final source-domain rather than eating.
topics.reason: The supplied variant functions as contrast only; the local surface is the knowledge verb under negation.

topics.headline: knowledge limit becomes the final boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah's final sound and same-surah knowledge thread make human non-knowledge the boundary around all created pairs.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows connect the final verb to knowledge contrasts at 2:30, 36:16, 36:26, and 36:76, and to the ayah's closure position.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: khalaqa al-azwaja kullaha and the three coordinated source phrases beginning with mimma or wa-min
baseline_models.mechanism: Creative bringing-forth, relational counterparting, and kull-totality combine with three source bands: earth-growth, their own selves, and an explicitly unknown remainder.

activation_trace.role: Bringing creation into existence supplies the productive act behind the whole mechanism.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart supplies the relational unit being created.
Encircling totality makes the claim comprehensive rather than illustrative.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the ecological source band.
Fertile, growth-bearing earth makes the first source materially generative.
The self as the thing's own identity supplies an embodied and reflexive source band.
Knowledge as disclosure, here negated, leaves a constitutive domain beyond human recognition.

changed_reading.before: A praise formula followed by examples of created couples.
changed_reading.after: Praise is grounded in an exhaustive relational ordering whose botanical and embodied instances open onto a real, unclosed domain of unknown counterparts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: al-azwaja kullaha, especially beside what the earth grows
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch of zawj as a kind, color, or class fits the plural products of earth and prevents azwaj from being restricted to visibly sexed couples.

activation_trace.role: Kinds or classes of a thing broaden pairhood into differentiated created types.
Total inclusion extends the class reading across the full field.
The many forms of earth-emergent vegetation provide the clearest concrete class domain.

changed_reading.after: Azwaj also names the complete range of mutually differentiated kinds, including botanical types whose pairing need not be overtly sexual.

baseline_models.mechanism: The final source clause is not a miscellaneous footnote: negated knowing is grammatically parallel to earth and selves, so epistemic inaccessibility is itself one of the verse's organizing domains.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower, when negated, marks a boundary of human access.
Unknown kinds remain members of the created classification even before they can be named.
Comprehensiveness requires the unknown domain rather than allowing knowledge to exhaust creation.

changed_reading.before: The last clause merely predicts undiscovered species.
changed_reading.after: The last clause establishes non-knowledge as a structural horizon within the total claim, leaving kinds, relations, and mechanisms open beyond current recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The unseen and the later balance of concealed and declared material place human non-knowledge inside a hidden/manifest relation, while repeated knowing assigns access to the divine knower.

activation_trace.role: Counterpart relation anchors the hidden and manifest sides back in azwaj.
Negated disclosure supplies the focus ayah's human knowledge boundary.
What is screened from eyes supplies a positive hidden domain rather than a merely absent object.
Complete knowing governs both sides of the concealed/declared contrast.
Concealment in the interior supplies one pole of an epistemic pairing.
Manifest disclosure supplies the counter-pole to inward concealment.

structural_cues: 36:11 treats the unseen as an operative field of response.
36:76 balances what they conceal and what they declare under one repeated claim of knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unseen, concealed, declared, and divine knowing; I infer that their polarity activates azwaj and deepens the focus negation. A live alternative is that these are epistemic themes without semantic pressure on azwaj itself.

changed_reading.before: What they do not know is only a stock of not-yet-discovered external kinds.
changed_reading.after: The unknown also includes concealed counterparts and interiors paired with manifest exteriors, all knowable in principle to the Creator while inaccessible to human survey.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dead earth becomes living growth, day is peeled from night, and ignitable fire issues from green tree. Pairhood therefore activates as a productive coupling of contrary states, not only a static inventory of coexisting members.

activation_trace.role: Counterpart relation anchors the conversion sequences as possible modes of azwaj.
Earth-emergent growth connects the focus directly to the first life/death conversion.
Lifeless earth supplies the inert starting pole.
Earth made alive through rain and vegetation supplies the opposed realized pole.
Skin-stripping gives the day/night transition a material image of one state withdrawn from another.
Tender green vegetation supplies a wet, living-seeming pole.
Kindled fire supplies the apparently contrary product latent in green tree.
Active ignition turns the green/fire contrast into a conversion rather than a juxtaposition.

structural_cues: The focus follows the revived-earth and fruit sequence of 36:33-35 and immediately precedes the day/night sequence of 36:37-40.
36:80 later compresses green plant and fire into a single production statement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three explicit transitions; I supply the arrow that these transitions exemplify azwaj as coupled contraries. They may instead be independent signs that only surround, rather than define, the focus claim.

changed_reading.before: All pairs are a catalogue of fixed complementary entities.
changed_reading.after: All pairs can include transition-linked contraries in which creation discloses one state through, from, or against its counterpart.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sun and moon are measured into distinct courses that neither collapse nor overtake, while all move in an orbit. This revises created pairing into maintained relational spacing and coordinated motion.

activation_trace.role: Creation as prior measuring supplies designed fit rather than undirected association.
Making one thing a counterpart to another anchors the measured courses in azwaj.
Continuous running supplies a dynamic rather than static relation.
Deliberate ordering by measure supplies the directional design of the courses.
A bounded measure supplies staged lunar limits.
Precedence and racing, explicitly blocked in the clause, preserve distinction between counterpart courses.
The celestial track supplies a common field that holds distinct motions together.
Swimming or running through a medium supplies the coordinated motion of all members.

structural_cues: 36:38-40 places sun, moon, night, and day in parallel but non-colliding courses immediately after the focus.
36:40 reuses the focus root س ب ح as a motion verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured stages, blocked overtaking, a shared orbit, and swimming motion; I infer that these explain a functional mode of created pairing. The alternative is that the celestial signs merely follow the focus without modifying azwaj.

changed_reading.before: A pair is two members placed together.
changed_reading.after: A created pair may be a maintained relation: distinct members share a field, keep measured intervals, and operate through coordinated but non-collapsing courses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The carried descendants, the laden vessel, and created rideable likenesses make counterparting functional and analogical: differently formed things can be paired by performing a corresponding carrying role.

activation_trace.role: The branch explicitly permits similar as well as opposed counterparts, anchoring functional analogy in azwaj.
Bearing a visible load supplies the shared function.
A vessel moving in water supplies one carrier form.
Created bringing-forth explicitly produces the analogous carrier.
Likeness and counterparting connect unlike carrier forms by correspondence.
Riding supplies the human use that makes the created likeness operational.
A second creation-by-likeness statement confirms analogy as a live mode of counterpart production.

structural_cues: 36:41-42 moves directly from a laden vessel to things created from its likeness for riding.
36:81 returns to the capacity to create their likeness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two carrier forms joined by mithl and creation; I infer that functional correspondence can instantiate azwaj beyond sex or shared material. The alternative is that mithl compares conveyances without feeding back into the focus term.

changed_reading.before: Pairs are generated only through biological mating or visible binary form.
changed_reading.after: Pairs can also be created analogues: materially different forms matched by a corresponding function, leaving the unknown domain open to relations recognized by use rather than anatomy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing argument moves from first origination through every creation and complete knowledge to creative capacity, immediate coming-to-be, and renewed praise. The focus creation of all pairs becomes a local demonstration of repeatable creative power.

activation_trace.role: Transcendent praise opens the focus claim and supplies one end of the surah-level frame.
Creative origination is the focus act later reapplied to restoration.
Total inclusion prepares the closing claim about every creation.
Human non-knowledge contrasts with the closing attribution of complete creative knowledge.
Bringing a thing into being supplies the first-origination premise.
Beginning and priority mark the original creative event.
An occurrence in time and its repeatability supply the bridge from first creation to re-creation.
Every creation repeats the focus totality at the close.
Creation is restated as the object of comprehensive knowledge.
Complete knowing reverses the human non-knowing at the focus.
Effective capacity supplies the ability to perform creation again.
Coming into actual presence supplies the terminal effect of the creative command.
Renewed transcendence closes the same praise frame that introduced the focus act.

structural_cues: 36:79 repeats kull, khalq, and alim in one clause, reversing the focus's human non-knowing.
36:77-82 moves from a drop and disputed resurrection through first origination, creative capacity, and immediate coming-to-be.
36:83 repeats subhan and kull at the surah close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated focus vocabulary and a first-creation-to-restoration argument; I infer that creating all pairs functions as evidence of re-creative capacity. The alternative is that 36:36 remains an independent sign with only rhetorical, not mechanistic, linkage to resurrection.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a self-contained natural-history observation.
changed_reading.after: The focus is also a compact premise in the surah's re-creation argument: power that originates exhaustive and partly unknowable relational life is not exhausted by its first occurrence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The activation is surprising because it crosses from doxological transcendence to the motion branch of the same root. It remains anchored in focus subhan and the exact root repetition at 36:40, but downstream prose should present this as imagistic resonance and must not translate subhan as swimming.

activation_trace.role: Transcendence and exoneration give the focus word its direct doxological force.
Swimming or running in a medium activates a kinetic echo within the immediately following cosmic pair system.
The return to transcendence at the close contains the kinetic echo inside a doxological frame.

changed_reading.before: Subhan is a static prefatory formula unrelated to the created systems that follow.
changed_reading.after: Without changing its translation, subhan can resonate with the ceaseless swimming of measured counterparts, making praise feel dynamically enacted by ordered motion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain and odd because it moves from generative or taxonomic pairs to juridical counter-agency within one person. It remains anchored in min anfusihim and azwaj, with the person's own mouth, hands, and feet redistributed into opposed roles at 36:65; downstream prose should label it a structural self-pairing, not a lexical definition of azwaj.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: wa-min anfusihim read together with al-azwaj

activation_trace.role: The self as one's own identity anchors the activation inside the human person.
Counterpart relation permits differentiated agencies within the anchored self.
A preventing seal disables the usual speaking organ and forces a role reversal.
Intelligible speech transfers from mouth to hands.
The acting hand becomes a speaking counterpart to the silenced mouth.
Witnessing with presence turns bodily members into counter-agents within the self.
The feet supply a second embodied witness distinct from the person's ordinary voice.
Acquired action is the shared object that links actor and bodily witness.

changed_reading.before: From themselves refers only to human reproductive pairing.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the self can generate counterpart agencies within its own embodied identity: organs of action later become organs of testimony against the ordinary speaking self.

strongest_changes: Azwaj shifted from a static inventory to measured relations among distinct, non-colliding courses.
The surrounding signs activated pairhood as conversion between contrary states: dead and living earth, night and day, green tree and fire.
The unknown became an access boundary structured by hidden and manifest realities, while the closing sequence connected pair-creation to re-creation.
Created likenesses opened a functional-analogy model in which materially different forms become counterparts through corresponding use.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly returned the focus roots and constructions: the motion branch of س ب ح immediately after the focus, kull-khalq-alim at 36:79, and subhan-kull at 36:83. Those recurrences made the ayah operate as a hinge between earth-growth, cosmic coordination, embodied accountability, and re-creation.
remaining_uncertainties: The astronomical sequence may exemplify signs beside azwaj without semantically expanding it.
Hidden/manifest polarity and divided bodily witness may extend pairhood beyond what the focus construction itself licenses.
The mithl passages may compare carriers and recreated beings independently of azwaj rather than instantiate functional counterparts.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Pairing is a comprehensive generative grammar.** `س ب ح` B002 declares free of limitation; `خ ل ق` B001 measures/proportions; `ز و ج` B001 is paired counterpart; `ك ل ل` B003 totality; `ن ب ت` B001 emergent growth. Earth, selves, and unknown domains expand one relational pattern. I infer that paired difference is a measured engine of production rather than accidental duplication. The ayah reads as a claim about creation's generative organization.
2. **Unknown pairs limit human closure.** `ن ف س` B013 is inner mind, and `ع ل م` B001 knowing as clear. The final category explicitly exceeds human knowledge, while 36:77-82 later exposes confident argument from a tiny origin. I infer that unseen pairing blocks inference from present knowledge to impossibility. The glorification reads as epistemic restraint as well as praise.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 36:56's spouses and 36:81's creation of their likeness activated pairing at social and recreative scales. The unknown-pairs clause remained a check against closing either domain prematurely.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Pairing is a measured architecture extending beyond sexuality.** **خ ل ق B001** anchors measuring/proportioning in **خَلَقَ**; **ز و ج B001** supplies paired counterparts and **ز و ج B004** kinds/varieties; **ك ل ل B003** supplies totality; and **ن ب ت B001** anchors earth-growth. The forward window immediately supplies night/day, sun/moon, running/resting, and distinct non-overtaking courses (36:37–40), while 36:41 adds ship-carriage. Those relations are supplied; the abduction is *pairing organizes complementary and contrasting operations across biological and cosmic systems*. **ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا** therefore exceeds a catalogue of male/female pairs.
2. **Purification removes the creator from the paired inventory.** **س ب ح B002** anchors **سُبْحَٰنَ** as declaring free and distancing; **ن ف س B012** gives **أَنفُسِهِمْ** whole self-identity; and **ع ل م B001** anchors the limit in **لَا يَعْلَمُونَ**. The ayah divides pairs among earth, selves, and unknown domains. The packet gives an exhaustive created set plus epistemic incompleteness; the inferred arrow is *declaring transcendence prevents the measurer from being treated as one measured counterpart within the set*. The opening exclamation performs a category boundary.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: **Later surprise.** 36:37–40 realizes pairing as night/day, sun/moon, motion/settlement, and non-overtaking courses; 36:41 then adds vessel/medium carriage. The later sequence confirms that **ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ** names operational complementarity across domains.

baseline.text: Toprağın yetiştirdiklerinden, kendilerinden ve bilmedikleri şeylerden bütün çiftleri yaratan eksiklikten uzaktır.

findings.text: Çiftler, yalnızca cinsiyetleri değil biyolojik ve kozmik süreçlerdeki tamamlayıcı ve karşıt işleyişleri düzenleyen kapsamlı bir yapı oluşturur.
Eksiklikten uzaklık ilanı, yaratıcıyı ölçülen çiftler kümesinin bir karşı üyesi saymayı engelleyen bir kategori sınırı çizer.
Bilinmeyen çiftlerin varlığı, mevcut bilgiden hareketle gelecekteki yaratma imkânlarını kapatmayı engeller.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, Tanrı'yı her türlü kötülük ve eksiklikten uzak sayma çekirdeğini ortak biçimde verir; yüceltici kalıp, genel eylem ve Tanrısal niteleme bu çekirdeğin ayrı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal kulluk eyleminin bütünü değil, Tanrı'nın kötülükten ve eksiklikten uzak olduğunu bildiren yargı ve nitelemeleri kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın eylem ve niteleme ile kalıplaşmış sözler birlikte bulunur; kalıpların şaşma veya ilişiksiz sayma işlevi genel çekirdeğe yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Tanrı'yı her türlü kötülükten, kusurdan ve kendisine yakışmayan nitelikten uzak sayarak yüceltmedir. Belirli söz kalıplarında bu uzak tutma, şaşma veya bir iddiadan ilişiksiz sayma işlevi de kazanır.

facets.statement: Tanrı'yı her türlü kötülük ve eksiklikten uzak sayıp yüceltme.
Tanrı için kullanılan bir niteleme, onun kendisine yakışmayan her şeyden uzak olduğunu belirtir.
Belirli bir söz kalıbı, şaşma ya da bir kişiyi veya şeyi öne sürülen iddiadan uzak tutma bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar Tanrı'yı kötülük ve eksiklikten uzak sayma konusunda birleşir; aynı uzaklaştırma düşüncesi bazı kalıplarda şaşma ve ilişiksiz sayma işlevine uzanır.

concept_gloss.text: Tanrı'yı her türlü eksiklikten uzak sayma

error_profile.preserves: Uzaklık bildirme ve şaşma işlevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Tanrı'yı eksiklikten uzak sayan temel dinî yargıyı içermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiyi öne sürülen övünme veya iddiadan ilişiksiz sayan kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bir iddiadan uzak tutma ve ilişiksiz sayma işlevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Şaşma işlevini ve Tanrı'ya yönelik temel yüceltme anlamını dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskın okuması Tanrı'nın yüzüne bağlanan görkem, büyüklük ve ışıktır; aynı toplu kanıt ayrıca yere kapanma yerleri biçiminde ayrı bir yorum taşır ve bu yorum çekirdekle özdeşleştirilemez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Görkem ve ışık temel okuma, yere kapanma yerleri ise bağımlı bir kaynak varyantıdır; ikisi tek bir fiziksel nesne gibi birleştirilmemelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Görkem ve ışık okuması yüzle kurulan belirli tamlamaya bağlıdır; yalın çoğul biçime verilen yere kapanma yerleri yorumu ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Temel okumada Tanrı'nın yüzüne bağlanan görkem, büyüklük ve ışıktır. Ayrı bir kaynak yorumunda aynı çoğul biçim yere kapanma yerlerini bildirir.

facets.statement: Tanrı'nın yüzüne bağlanan görkem, büyüklük ve ışık.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıtın çoğu görkem, büyüklük ve ışık okumasında birleşirken, ayrıca yere kapanma yerleri biçiminde uyuşmayan bir yorum da aktarılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi suda yüzmeyi ve su ya da havada hızlı ilerlemeyi çekirdek yapar; yıldızların yörüngedeki akışı ile atın ön ayaklarını uzatarak koşması bu hareket biçiminin açık uzantılarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal fiziksel ve benzetmeli akıcı hareketi kapsar; geçim için serbest zaman ve hareket alanı anlamı ayrı daldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın yüzme ve hızlı ilerleme anlamı, yıldız ve atla kurulan kalıplardan ayrılır; özel öznelerin kapsamı genel harekete zorla yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Suda yüzerek ya da su ve havada hızlı, akıcı biçimde ilerlemedir. Yıldızların yörüngede akması ve atın koşarken ön ayaklarını ileri uzatması bu hareket imgesinin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Suda yüzme veya su ve havada hızlı, akıcı biçimde ilerleme.
Yıldızların yörüngede akıp ilerlemesi aynı hareket imgesiyle anlatılır.
Atın koşarken ön ayaklarını ileri uzatması yüzmeye benzetilen özel bir koşu biçimidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar suda yüzme çekirdeğinde birleşir ve akıcı, hızlı ilerleme imgesini havadaki harekete, yıldızların yörüngesine ve atın koşuşuna genişletir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki ayrı kapsam taşır: yalın biçim çocuklar için deriden yapılmış gömlek veya giysiyi, belirli bir tamlama ise güçlü ve sıkı bir örtüyü anlatır. Ortak giysi alanı bunların anlamlarını birleştirmeye yetmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Deri çocuk giysisi dalın yalın nesne anlamıdır; güçlü ve sıkı örtü yalnız kendi tamlamasına bağlı ayrı bir nitelemedir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın giysi adı ile tamlamaya bağlı güçlü örtü nitelemesi ayrı tutulur; örtünün güç niteliği bütün deri giysilere yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yalın kullanımda çocuklar için deriden yapılan gömlek veya giysidir. Belirli bir tamlamada ise güçlü, sağlam ve sıkı bir örtüyü niteler.

facets.statement: Çocuklar için deriden yapılmış gömlek veya giysi.
Belirli bir tamlamada güçlü, sağlam ve sıkı bir örtü nitelemesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt çocuklar için deri gömlek veya giysi anlamını verir ve ayrıca yalnız belirli bir tamlamada örtünün güçlü, sağlam oluşunu bildirir.

concept_gloss.text: çocuk deri giysisi; güçlü ve sıkı örtü

error_profile.preserves: Deri çocuk giysisini ve kalıba bağlı güçlü örtü anlamını ayrı ayrı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalın biçimin çocuk giysisini anlattığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gömlek veya genel giysi biçimini anlatır; komşu dal ise şeritler hâlinde kesilip kuşanılan belirli deri parçasını anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Deri malzeme ve erkek çocuklara yönelik kullanım odak dalda belirtilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Güçlü ve sıkı olma yalnız belirli bir örtü tamlamasında gerçekleşir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dokuma yoğunluğundan doğan kumaş gücü ve bunun insan aklına uzanan kullanımı komşu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kumaş veya örtünün dayanıklı ve güçlü oluşunu anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli bir örtüyü güçlü diye niteler; komşu dal gücü dokumanın çokluğu ve malzemenin tamamlığıyla açıklar, ayrıca insan niteliğine uzanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek biçimi kutsal kent ya da hac sırasında durulan bölgedeki bir vadi için kullanılan yer adı olarak verir; geçici çerçeve bu iki olası gönderimi doğru yansıtır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, nesnenin kesilmesi ya da işlenmesi öncesinde ölçülmesini ve sınırlarının uygun biçimde belirlenmesini ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Deri örneği bu işlemi somutlaştırır; yoktan var etme ve yalan uydurma anlamları bu dalın parçası değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, eylemden önceki ölçme ve sınır belirleme aşamasıyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın ölçme ve biçme anlamını karşılar; başka dallardaki kalıplaşmış kullanımlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesneyi kesme ya da uygulama öncesinde ölçüp sınırlarını uygun ve düzgün biçimde belirlemektir.

facets.statement: Nesnenin ölçüsü ve sınırları yapılacak işten önce belirlenir.
Bir deri parçasını kesmeden önce tuluma göre ölçmek bu işlemin örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, anlamı ölçme, oranlama ve kesmeden önce sınır koyma çevresinde birleştirir; düzgün ve uygun ölçü vurgusu da bu çekirdeği tamamlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin yapılacak işe göre önceden ölçülüp biçildiği genel bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ön ölçme ve sınır belirleme işlemlerinin ikisini de korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deri, kumaş veya benzeri bir nesnenin kesime hazırlanmasını anlatan bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ölçmenin eylemden önce geldiğini ve kesime yöneldiğini korur.
Önceden bir değer belirleme düşüncesini kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Nesneyi ölçme ve uygulama sınırlarını belirleme işlemlerini kaybeder.
error_profile.collision: Belirsiz bir kestirimle ölçüye dayalı hazırlığı birbirine karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yapılacak nesnenin ölçü ve sınırlarını eylemden önce belirler.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Nesneyi gerçekten ortaya çıkarma ve var etme eylemini anlatır.
